label: gym_mizu_010_mizu_01
text: Vaultin’ Veluza! I’m late! I’m late![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: gym_mizu_010_receptionist_02
text: Ahhh, he got away. How am I supposed to\nreturn this to him now...?

label: gym_mizu_010_receptionist_03
text: Oh, hey! You’re here as a Gym challenger, right?

label: gym_mizu_010_receptionist_04a
text: I knew it! Of course you are!

label: gym_mizu_010_receptionist_04b
text: You can’t fool me. You’re definitely a challenger!

label: gym_mizu_010_receptionist_05
text: That big man that just left is Kofu, leader\nof the Cascarrafa Gym.

label: gym_mizu_010_receptionist_06
text: He has a bit of a childlike side to him, and today\nhe’s run off to the market without his wallet.

label: gym_mizu_010_receptionist_07
text: He’ll be in big trouble without it...\c\nThat’s where you come in, kind Gym challenger!\nCould you please take Kofu’s wallet to him?

label: gym_mizu_010_receptionist_08a
text: Ohhh! You are too kind! I’d give you a Gym\nBadge right now if I could!

label: gym_mizu_010_receptionist_08b
text: I’m sorry, but it’s impossible to challenge our\nGym without Kofu here. I can’t exactly leave my\r\npost here at the lobby, either, so...

label: gym_mizu_010_receptionist_09
text: Here’s his wallet! I’m counting on you!

label: gym_mizu_010_receptionist_10
text: This can be your Gym Test here. If you do this for\nme, you pass!

label: gym_mizu_010_receptionist_11
text: Kofu’s headed to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Porto Marinada[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]. It’s on the\nother side of the desert to the west.

label: gym_mizu_010_receptionist_12
text: Be careful, though. There are many dangerous\nPokémon in the desert!
